label: LOCAL DEVELOPMENT / PRELIMINARY SIMULATION -- mock LLM, synthetic cases, NOT AN OFFICIAL SCORE

categories.D: discriminator was available but not selected
categories.E: correct EXAM existed but was skipped

scope: Every critical false negative in the post-W baseline over all development suites (preliminary 230, same-condition fixtures, Round W closing, post-W counterfactual set). Preliminary suites had 0 critical misses (85/85).
finding: All five were evidence-representation failures (F): the candidate was generated, kept and usually led, but the observations that make it nameable were not recognised. None needed a safety boost; each class was fixed by representing the missing sign once (KB feature + wording grammar) and verified on unseen wordings and negative controls.

failures.set: frozen_validation_round_w_closing (consumed in Round W; now development-used)
failures.trace: 5-month-old: fever + 'soft spot on his head is bulging' + vomiting; caregiver adds 'high-pitched cry'. Candidate generated and safety-watched (A/C no); evidence: only 'fever' matched because the KB meningitis profile had no infant signs and no grammar linked fontanelle/soft-spot or cry wording -> naming blocked as single nonspecific support; DIAGNOSE fell to undifferentiated.
failures.cause: evidence parser / knowledge gap: infant meningitis signs (bulging fontanelle, high-pitched cry) not represented
failures.fix: meningitis typical_features 'bulging fontanelle on examination', 'high-pitched cry on examination' (NICE NG143 Table 1, NG240) with relation grammar EN/KO/JA; objective-only (never asked). Development fixture post_round_w_counterfactual_dev2 (4 new infant meningitis wordings + 3 negative controls) frozen before the change: 0/4 -> 4/4, controls unchanged
failures.status: FIXED (development; CloseW_01 is no longer independent evidence)

failures.trace: 2-month-old cold, floppy, not feeding, grey lips, Temp 35.4. Sepsis led but supported only by tachycardia/tachypnea -> 'only_hemodynamic_support' blocked naming. Hypothermia had no KB representation (only fever).
failures.cause: hypothermic sepsis presentation not represented (temperature below 36 C is a NICE NG51 criterion)
failures.fix: sepsis 'temperature below 36 degrees' as SUPPORT-ONLY measured threshold (fever never contradicts it)

failures.trace: 6-week-old grunting, not feeding, afebrile, pale/limp, exam 'Mottled, CRT 4 s'. Grunting and mottling unparsed; pallor + tachycardia let gi_bleeding lead.
failures.cause: NICE NG51 high-risk appearance signs (mottled, grunting) not represented
failures.fix: sepsis 'mottled skin on examination', 'grunting on examination' (objective-only) + lay aliases

failures.trace: Korean: 6-month-old afebrile, floppy, sleepy, not feeding; '피부가 얼룩덜룩'; Temp 35.6. Korean mottling unparsed; hypothermia unrepresented.
failures.fix: KO pattern 얼룩덜룩 -> mottled skin; low-temperature threshold

failures.trace: Noisy lay wording 'chest feels liek an elefant sitting on it' + sweaty + arm pain. Only 'diaphoresis' matched: the simile for chest pressure and the misspelling defeated the substernal-pressure grammar.
failures.fix: STERNAL_PRESSURE grammar: simile ('like/as if' + something sitting/pressing on chest, tolerant of 'liek') or explicit weight; 'the cat was sitting on my chest' still excluded

after_fixes: see artifacts/post_round_w/final/ (critical misses on the same suites after the fixes)
